name: Jenny Bakery Cookies
where: Jenny Bakery official shop, Sheung Wan or Tsim Sha Tsui
about: Jenny Bakery is a well-known Hong Kong bakery famous for its buttery cookies, which are packed in classic tins as gifts.
tip: Buy only from the official shop, because similar-sounding names sell copies.

name: Shou Pu-erh Tea
where: Ying Kee Tea House official shop
about: Shou pu-erh is a dark, fermented tea. Hong Kong's tea houses are a big part of local daily life, and this tea reflects that culture.
tip: Taste before you buy, then check the origin and aging period on the label.

name: XO Sauce
where: Kee Wah Bakery or the dried seafood shops on Sheung Wan's dried goods street
about: XO sauce is a rich condiment of dried seafood, chili, and garlic. It is a signature Hong Kong seasoning used in many local dishes.
